listings.title: An Eclectic Post-Modern Estate: Furniture, Fashion & Art
listings.description: After more than 30 years of memories, collecting, entertaining, and living, Eleanor’s home is ready for its next chapter. Eleanor was a longtime New Jersey boutique owner who successfully operated her business for more than three decades. Her incredible eye for style extended beyond the boutique and into her home, resulting in a collection filled with vintage treasures, unique furnishings, artwork, collectibles, fashion, home décor, and everyday pieces accumulated over a lifetime. After recently transitioning into her next chapter, we have spent considerable time thoughtfully sorting, purging, cleaning, organizing, and staging the home to uncover the treasures that have been tucked away over the years. This is a true dig-and-discover estate sale with a tremendous amount of inventory and something for a wide range of shoppers. Expect to find: Lots of clothing, shoes & accessories — there is still a substantial selection remaining from the boutique collection Vintage furniture & unique home furnishings Artwork, mirrors & decorative pieces Collectibles & vintage finds Kitchen & entertaining items Home décor & accessories Books, magazines & paper collectibles Household goods Unique one-of-a-kind pieces And plenty of unexpected treasures throughout the home Many of the items reflect Eleanor’s longtime appreciation for fashion, design, vintage style, and beautiful things, making this much more than a typical household sale. We have worked hard to create an organized and enjoyable shopping experience while still preserving the fun of discovering something unexpected around the next corner. Come ready to explore — there are decades of memories, fashion, furnishings, and treasures waiting to find their next home. PLEASE NOTE: This is the second and final weekend of the sale, following our dedicated fashion sale featuring the boutique inventory. While a portion of the clothing and accessories will have been sold during the first weekend, there will still be lots of clothing and accessories available during this sale, along with the many other contents of the home. Some items may have been sold or removed prior to this event, and photographs may not represent every item that will be available at the time of the sale. We will do our best to keep the listing updated as the sale approaches. We look forward to welcoming you and helping these pieces begin their next chapter!
